VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 72 tests pass and provides technical details about the fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 72 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
